notes.title: Soul Axiom is Content Complete!!

What's New?
The finale is here! If you've completed enough Zero levels then congratulations, your Central Visitation Beam (Find the related PEMO for more details) is now available to use! We’re proud to announce that Soul Axiom is content complete which means we can now look over the entire game to be touched up ready for the Early Access switch to be flipped. 


Multiple Endings
With this update comes the final chapter of the game and we are giving you the chance to choose your own ending! Don’t worry, you won’t miss out on any gameplay, after completing the game you are free to revisit the Waiting Room to complete the endings of your choice. Without giving anything away, each ending consist of two scenarios with one bonus scenario depending on which path you take… you won’t want to miss it! Don't forget, you will need to have completed most Zero levels to gain access to the Waiting Room and ALL Zero's to unlock all three endings. 


http://i.imgur.com/MCA39bb.jpg

Achievements
All Achivements are in! anyone who wants to 100% the game this is now possible! let us know if you have any problems with them.

Early Access Contributor? We Need To Hear From You!
That’s right, we need your input now more than ever. With just weeks left of development we’re looking to tighten up the game with an immediate focus on everything from the Waiting Room to very end of the game. The EA community have been exceptional and although it’s an exciting time for us finishing the game, it’s also coming to the end of what’s become a truly awesome community. Speaking of which…


Top Contributors
We promised a select few members from the community would get a special mention in the credits to say thank you for your contribution on the Early Access forums. Unfortunately, we couldn’t choose everyone from the forums but we want to thank you all for your contributions along the way. Look out for your name in the credits and if you’d like to make a correction (as some Steam names may have changed since) then you have some time to get in touch with us. notes.title: New Visual/Gameplay Content & Complete Optimisation
notes.content:
http://i.imgur.com/zmqxNRk.jpg

Greetings Everybody!

We're back with a brand new update featuring new visual and gameplay content and our biggest optimisation and lighting pass to date! 

If you missed our last announcement then follow this link where we announced the recent engine upgrade and explained why we rebuilt the level lighting from the ground up which has given the game a whole new bunch of benefits. 

What's New?

Optimisation

Our biggest result of the update is the overall framerate throughout the entire game. Depending on what system spec you're running, you should notice a big difference in framerate and shouldn't experience any sudden drops in areas in the game. This is still a work-in-progress and we have found new ways to increase the FPS so expect to see more improvement after the game is content complete. We’re aiming for 60 FPS with most levels and are already hitting those targets in some. If you experience any further framerate drops then let us know in the bugs forum. 

Visual Improvements

The force behind the huge optimisation pass was down to completely rebuilding the lighting and improving shader work in all chapters of the game. Some levels will have subtle changes whilst others will have had a complete makeover. You’ll notice some levels are now darker and this is because we’ve increased the glow from your powers which you can use to light up your surroundings and essentially act as a torch. 
Some of the more noticeable levels that have visually been improved include Ice Palace, Church, Space Station, Mansion and University. Check out the new animated werewolves in the Mansion and new and improved gargoyles in the Church! We’ve also gone through and updated various textures and props to keep it in line with the rest of the game.

We’re glad to say that EGX was a big result for us, with Nintendo featuring the game on their stand which is a huge achievement for us. We were right in there with some of the biggest games around and to our delight, Soul Axiom was one of the most asked after game in the Nindies section on the Nintendo stand. http://i.imgur.com/TS7yZOz.jpg

So, with this update comes the fourth and final power! We also have three new locations to explore to get your new power and a further four new levels! Though, these aren’t levels as you’d expect them so read on to find out more…

NOTE TO THE COMMUNITY: We are looking for feedback on the Corrupt tutorial in the Tree Of Life level. Please get back to us with your thoughts on this and what you got from it. Did it take you long to get to grips with what you had to do and what the different Corrupt nodes do? If it’s possible and if you’d really like to take your support one step further, we would love to see a video playthrough of everything from the Forest levels to finishing the Zero levels. What's New?

We promised you an update at the end of the week and here it is! This time it consists of brand new content to get your hands on as well as a few minor bug fixes throughout the game. So, what's new in the world of Elysia? 

 A brand new level has been unlocked! The Museum contains a diverse range of areas which will further challenge your puzzle-solving skills. Use your new powers to Phase and Play your way through Shadows of Mexico, Dino Jungle, The World of Tomorrow, Sand & Blood: Ancient Egypt and Sharky's World of Sharks!

 Discover art, natural history and marine life as you explore around dinosaurs, whales, sharks, robots, hoverboards, hieroglyphics, sarcophagi, ancient skulls and even... Piñatas!

 More of those delightful monkeys (PEMO's) to deliver the info you need to piece together the story. Have you found them all? There may be more than you think so explore each level... including the HUB!

 CUTSCENES! Every level will now contain a cutscene at the end. What do they mean? That's for your to find out.

 A new atmospheric sound track has been added to the HUB. Check it out and let us know what you think in the comments.
